title: Mahmoud–Qi and Zhu completely-monotonic-degree conjectures
statement: Let $n\ge 2$ and define the signed Stirling remainder, for $x>0$, by $R_n(x)=\log\Gamma(x)-\left(x-\frac12\right)\log x+x-\frac12\log(2\pi)-\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{B_{2k}}{2k(2k-1)x^{2k-1}}$. For each $m\ge 0$, set $F_{n,m}(x)=(-1)^{n+m}R_n^{(m)}(x)$. Determine exactly the completely monotonic degree $d_{n,m}=\sup\{r\in\mathbb{R}:x^rF_{n,m}(x)\text{ is completely monotonic on }(0,\infty)\}$, where a function $g$ is completely monotonic if $(-1)^jg^{(j)}(x)\ge 0$ for every integer $j\ge 0$ and every $x>0$. In particular, determine the exact real degrees for the signed Stirling remainders and all their derivatives, beyond the previously conjectured integer-degree formulas.
references: - [Noninteger completely monotonic degrees of Stirling remainders and their derivatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33699) — arXiv — Valmir Krasniqi

progress.label: Open · progress reported
progress.tldr: A new paper claims the conjectured formulas are wrong, gives tight bounds and asymptotic information, but does not determine the exact degrees.
progress.summary:
The problem concerns conjectural formulas for completely monotonic degrees associated with Stirling remainders and their derivatives, proposed in work of Mahmoud, Qi, and Zhu. The exact real degrees were not previously determined.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33699)*

**October 2026 development**

Valmir Krasniqi's paper claims that the predicted real degrees fail, each degree lies strictly between consecutive integers, and the conjectured integer formula is recovered in its stated range. It also determines the asymptotic order of the fractional excess. The exact real degrees and optimal asymptotic constants remain open; these claims are unverified.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33699)*

Current status (as of October 2026): A preprint claims substantial progress and refutes the predicted real-degree formulas, but the exact degrees and optimal asymptotic constants remain open.

*Caveats. The reported advance comes from a single specialist preprint and has not been independently verified.*
